entities.name: plain-walled house with the pole scaffold on its roof
entities.what: A single-storey tiled house on the bank with a long plain plastered front wall (no door or window painted) under a valance of scalloped hanging cloth and a bracket frieze; its roof has a light triangular gable facing the river in its east half, with a lattice board under the gable, and a small hip-gable end at its west end. A great scaffold of lashed poles stands on the roof ridge running back from the gable: uprights, two or three levels of cross-bars and braces, the pole tips sharpened and splayed like a crown (u 24880-25240, up to the silk's top edge). A long pole sticks out west from the scaffold's foot with a banner of three dark vertical stripes on light cloth with a wavy hem hanging from it. At the west end a big curved mat awning sweeps out and up from the wall over a stall (the stall, its table and people are t6's), held by a post at the wall's west corner. No writing on the house itself. A two-lobed ridge-end ornament (鸱尾) stands on the main ridge's west end (u 24829-24849, v 247-269).
entities.vis: part: back and north corners hidden by its own roof, the scaffold and the hall roofs behind; foot of the wall in the bank wash
entities.note: Wall: west edge (a post) u 24740-24747, east end post 25203-25217, foot v 500 (west) to ~505 (east), top under the valance v ~404; valance/frieze v 364-404; front eave v 356-364 (25204) to ~378 (west end). A faint vertical at u 24867 (v 420-497) is a wall joint or post. Gable (south-facing) apex (25060,228), eave feet (24975,300)/(25162,330), lattice board under it v 304-314 (u 25000-25120). West end: a small hip-gable u 24775-24840, v 312-380. Two small dark knobs at the ridge's west end, (24838,255) and (24867,245): the left has two lobes like a ridge-end ornament (鸱尾), the right a squared cap over a lighter patch like a man's head; t6 recorded both as heads (head_over_roof_w_24840 (retired at the second pass), S2.fig.head_over_roof_e_24867, conf low). My reading: the left is more likely an ornament, the right undecided; settle at the merge. SCAFFOLD: poles from (24880,245) at its low west end rising east to tips at v 20-40 (u 25000-25240), its east edge u ~25235 (v 30-167); its lower edge runs (24880,245)->(25230,160), slope about -0.25, the crown line (24880,100)->(25224,22) about -0.23: it stands along the roof ridge running back (north) from the gable apex, its east part above the tall rear hall's west roof slope. Second reading: a free-standing building scaffold on the ground behind the house, its feet hidden by the roofs. The restyle draws it the same; the restyle's willow at u 24600-24900 is the scaffold's pole tips plus t6's pole stack and this banner. BANNER: pole (24745,178)->(24913,183), cloth u 24747-24819, v 183-267. AWNING: a sweeping mat awning, upper edge (24566,426)->(24642,336)->(24790,292), dark underside u 24610-24745, v 336-420, post at the wall corner (24742, 392-496); it is fixed to the house, so it is part of it. North corners are placeholders (back wall hidden), set straight back at v ~230-250. SCALE CUES: wall 95-100 px tall at foot v 500 (about 1.4 m at the bank figures' 70 px/m); front 460 px long. Second pass (middle) and FRAME AGENT: the west knob at the ridge's west end is the ridge-end ornament (the two lobes join a neck that runs straight into the ridge line at ridge_end_w; g_ridge.jpg, zoom 6), so t6's head_over_roof_w_24840 (retired at the second pass) is retired; the east knob stays a low head (S2.fig.head_over_roof_e_24867), or a ridge beast.

entities.name: open-fronted shop with a dark curtain, west of the 沿河雅座 hall
entities.what: A shop open to the bank under a low front roof: a stepped rack of lattice-work goods inside (t7's prop), a shopkeeper behind it (t7), a big dark curtain hung from the eave beam and drawn up into a swag at its east end, and a narrow signboard with two or three illegible characters (□□□) hanging at its west end beside a tall pole (t6 recorded the board and pole as S2.prop.signboard_pole_25235). Tiled front roof with a heavy eave beam; the tall rear hall's roof rises behind it.
entities.vis: part: back hidden; floor line behind t7's two standing men and the moored boat's stern
entities.note: Front roof eave v 309-318, eave beam band v 314-332 (u 25235-25480); roof top (where the rear hall's roof shows above it) v ~197-205. Curtain u 25385-25453, v 332-427. West end: the scaffold house's east post u 25203-25217; the tall pole 25232-25240 (v 244-500, t6) stands at the shop's west corner; the board hangs u 25185-25210, v 288-360 (characters illegible at zoom 5, also in the restyle). East end at the hall's west posts (u ~25471-25480). Floor at bank level: post feet v ~495-505. Back corners placeholders. SCALE CUES: eave 185 px above the floor line at v 503; opening ~265 px wide. Second pass: two small objects hang from a beam inside the shop's west bay, behind the goods racks (S2.prop.goods_racks_25290): one at u 25277-25286 and one hook-shaped at u 25293-25303, both v 356-379 (wares, meat or lanterns hung up; t6 left them to structures_e, which did not name them). Part of this building (what hangs from a building is the structures agent's).

entities.name: tall hall behind the open shop (roof only)
entities.what: A tall tiled roof rising behind the open shop and the scaffold house to a round finial on a short pedestal at its peak; from the finial its eaves run down west behind the scaffold and down east to meet the 沿河雅座 hall's roof. A long paddle-shaped object lies on its east hip just below the finial (an oar or pole left on the roof, or a ridge ornament). Only the roof shows.

entities.note: Finial (25404-25418, 70-90). Upper roof edges: (25069,206)->(25410,77) on the west, (25410,85)->(25480,117)->(25563,135) on the east, where it meets the long hall roof's top edge (v ~145). A dark elongated mass lies along the east edge u 25487-25570, v 123-140. Paddle u 25439-25487, v 83-119 (blade up, a knob at its lower end); the restyle paints a wooden oar. TWO READINGS: (1) a separate tall hall north of the open shop (footprint placeholder, about u 25100-25560 between the open shop's back and the far street); (2) the upper roof of a two-storey building whose lower roof covers the open shop (then this and S2.bld.open_shop_25340 are one building). The scaffold's east part stands above its west slope. Footprint is a placeholder.

entities.name: 沿河雅座: the long riverside hall with open windows
entities.what: A long single-roofed hall along the bank, its room raised above the bank: a row of big open windows (window posts, open sashes) showing long tables and crossed-leg seats inside and a seated man at the west window (t7's figures and furniture), a balustrade-like lattice skirt of patterned panels under the sill, and posts below standing on the bank. One huge tiled roof covers it, running on east over the warehouse (S2.bld.warehouse_26070) without a break. No writing seen.
entities.vis: part: the bank foot behind the moored boats' mat roofs (river_m's boat at u 25150-25990); back hidden under the roof
entities.note: Eave v 347-361; window openings v ~384-462 between window posts at u ~25478, 25498, 25695, 25742, 25857, 25895; sill / room floor v 457-476; lattice skirt v 476-530; posts below the skirt at u 25768 and 25868 stand on the bank at v 565-566 (a plank band v 538-561 between them); west of 25640 the boat's mat roof covers v 538+. The room floor is about 100 px above the post feet: a raised floor. For t7's figures at the window: support `upper floor: S2.bld.yanhe_yazuo_hall_25690`, floor line v ~462-468, ground straight below v ~565. Roof: one slope from its top edge v ~145 (where the far street's figures stand behind it) to the eave; the far street hides its ridge. Back corners placed at the roof's top edge (placeholder). SCALE CUES: window openings ~77 px tall; floor ~100 px above the bank at v 565; posts 25768-25868 = 100 px apart.

entities.name: closed warehouse with lattice doors on a plank-faced platform
entities.what: East of the 沿河雅座 hall under the same long roof: a closed front of three bays of full-height lattice doors between plain posts, under an eave with a row of round tile ends, standing on a raised platform faced with horizontal planks; capped posts stand along the platform's face (t7/t8 record them as mooring posts). A storehouse by the moorings. No writing.
entities.vis: part: back hidden under the roof; platform foot partly behind the moored boat (river_e's, from u 26000)
entities.note: Eave tile-end row v 375-395. Lattice door panels u 25920-26020, 26025-26120, 26140-26230, v ~395-550; posts u 25905-25915, 26020-26025, 26125-26135, 26230-26240. Platform: top band v 555-575, plank face v 575-625, foot ~v 625; capped posts on its face at u ~25895, 26010, 26120 (v 560-600). The roof is continuous with the hall's from v ~145 to the eave; its east end shows a small gable at u 26470-26515, v 164-245 (behind S2.bld.white_wall_house_26330's roof). Recorded as a building of its own because the front changes (closed lattice doors on a plinth vs. the hall's open raised room); if the builder makes one roof for both, that is the painting. SCALE CUES: door bays ~100 px wide, 155 px tall (v 395-550); platform ~70 px high. Merge: t7 recorded the capped post at u ~26018 as a mooring bollard, S2.prop.mooring_post_26018 (conf med; post 65 px tall, v 565-630, about 15 px thick, a band at v ~595 that may be a tied rope), and named its twin at u ~26128; retired as part of this building: on the merge crops gen/map/S2/look/merge_post_26018.jpg and merge_post_26128.jpg both are uprights on the plank face directly under the bay posts at u 26020-26025 and 26125-26135, i.e. the posts carried down through the platform (structures_e, river_e: "pillar feet"), and no boat's rope is drawn to either (river_e). Other reading (t7): free-standing mooring posts in front of the plinth; then three props (u ~25895, 26018, 26128).

entities.name: white-walled house with a hipped roof at the east end of the halls
entities.what: A house with a plain white plastered front wall and a hipped tiled roof with a row of round tile ends at the eave, standing on the bank just east of the warehouse; its east end runs under the great willow's whips. No door or writing painted.

entities.name: tiled shed on the far street, with tables
entities.what: A small open shed on the far street at the very top of the silk: a tiled roof on four or five posts, tables and trestle benches under it (t7's props and people); a mat stall awning on a crossed pole stands just west of it (t7's prop).

entities.name: long tiled shed on the far street

entities.note: Roof u 26080-26440, v 20-80; posts at u ~26100 (v 60-140), 26205 (75-145), 26315 (75-150), 26380-26383 and 26420 (75-142). Back corners placeholders.

entities.what: A small hut on the far street west of the willow at the top: its front is a screen of close vertical slats (a reed or bamboo mat wall), and at its east end a doorway frame of two posts and a lintel opens on a light plastered wall; its roof is hidden by the willow's crown.

entities.note: Slats u 26443-26533, v 78-155; door posts u 26533-26540 and 26580-26587 (v 65-162), lintel v 65-82; light wall between them. The restyle paints a hut with a hanging straw mat and a gate with a little roof. It may be the east end of S2.bld.far_long_shed_26260 (its last post is at u ~26420), but the slat wall stands ~20 px further forward, so recorded alone. Back corners placeholders at the silk's top edge.

entities.name: small open shed (or post-and-beam frame) on the far street west of the 纸马铺 sign
entities.what: A small open structure of posts and beams on the far street under the willow whips, between the willow at the top and a man leading a donkey (t8's): two or three posts with cross-beams at two or three levels; its roof, if it has one, is hidden by the whips. Nothing stands under it.
entities.vis: part: top under willow whips; faint
entities.note: Posts at u ~26718-26725 (v 75-132), 26745 (v 85-135) and ~26780-26790 (v 80-130); beams at v ~78, 95-100 and ~110 from u 26710 to 26800. entities.name: 王家纸马铺: the Wang family's paper-offerings shop
entities.what: A long single-storey shop at the top of the wide east bank, open along its whole front under a tiled roof with a heavy eave beam: shelves and counters stacked with paper goods (paper horses and offerings for the Qingming rites). Its tall signboard on a post stands at its west end (t8's prop: 王家紙馬…); a tall stand heaped with paper offerings stands at its front (a prop, t9's). At its east end a light side wall and the roof's end turn back north; at its west end the roof ends in a rounded hip or gable end above the sign, with a dark slanting strut (an eave bracket, or the sign's hook) above the sign's cap.
entities.vis: part: back at the silk's top edge (v ~20 here)
entities.src: 名画记: 王家纸马铺 (pin 13); Hansen plate 8
entities.note: Roof v 20-90, eave v 90-105, eave beam v ~100-105; open front v 105-200 with shelves and goods; floor / step line v 195-203 from u 26915 to 27290. Posts at u ~26920, 26940, 26980, 27050, 27120, 27175, 27275-27287. East end: a light wall u 27287-27340, v 100-196, and the roof's edge rising (27287,103)->(27430,50) (its east verge or hip running back, slope -0.37). The sign (u 26880-26913, v 70-222) stands ~5 px west of the shop's west post. The paper-offering stand u 27045-27120, v 100-242 (base v ~240) stands in front of the posts at 27050-27120. Main point at u ~27100: sections.md's ≈ 26850 is the sign. Back corners at the silk's top edge (placeholder). WEST END: a rounded light shape with a dark outline at u 26905-26940, v 35-110, read as the roof's west hip or gable end (the restyle paints the roof's west end there; t9: or a bare tree top behind the roof, or a lamp); a dark slanted bar (26873,47)->(26910,63) above the sign's cap (t8: an eave strut or a hook on the sign). SCALE CUES: eave ~100 px above the floor line at v 200; front 375 px long.

entities.name: low wattle fence (or the willow's knobbed foot) with a small post-and-rail frame, under the great willow
entities.what: Under the west half of the great willow's knobbed head on the bank: a low block of close vertical hatching with a curved lower edge, like a wattle or reed fence, and at its east end a small frame of two posts and two rails (a gate, a rack or a prop under the tree's head).
entities.vis: part: top under the willow's knobbed head
entities.note: Hatched block u 26820/26840-26937, v 624-676, its lower edge curved (lowest (26890,676)); the post-and-rail frame u 26935-26970, v 624-662, rails at v ~640 and ~655. If (2), the merge keeps only the frame (as a t8/t9 prop). SCALE CUES: ~50 px tall at foot v 676; frame 35 px wide.

entities.name: slanted railing with balusters (a stair or ramp) between the pole frame and the tiled shed

A man's capped head shows just behind it (t10's S2.fig.man_at_railing_27650).

entities.what: A low tiled roof with a small gable at its east end, behind (north of) the big eating shed's roof (S2.bld.eating_shed_west_27300); a porter with a shoulder pole walks behind it (t9's).

entities.name: the big eating shed east of the great willow (喝杯小酒): tiled roof and mat awning

entities.name: the lower eating shed with a front gable, by the grain boats
entities.what: An open eating shed east of the big one, lower on the bank: a front gable over its middle, a low front roof and a flat awning on posts, a long counter beam at the back with slatted blinds and two dark cloths hung on the back rail; four tables with benches under it (t10's props) and a serving man deep inside (t10). Back counter beam v 658-662 (u 27560-27950) with slatted blinds v 665-730 and two dark cloths at u 27750-27787 (v 657-690). entities.name: tiled roof between the 望火楼 and the 望楼饭铺 (roof only)
entities.what: A long tiled roof running east behind the thatched 望楼饭铺 shed, at the foot of the 望火楼's platform, hiding the platform's foot and the stair's foot: the second row of the barracks-like sheds, or the tower's lower building; a small dark knob sits on its ridge (a ridge ornament, or a perched bird).
entities.vis: part: seen only as a roof between the platform and the thatched shed
entities.note: Roof u 28220-28540, top edge v ~281-285 (where the platform's brick face disappears), eave v ~345-350; its west end meets the tiled shed's east posts (u 28250-28275). It may be the tiled shed's roof continuing east (then one entity with S2.bld.tiled_shed_27985), but its eave stands ~40 px higher on the silk. Footprint placeholder. Ridge knob (28423-28434, v 279-287) (t11): a ridge ornament (the restyle draws one) or a bird; t11 did not record it as an animal. t11 reads this roof as the tiled shed's, running on from u 28000 to 28480.

entities.name: 望火楼: the brick platform of the fire-watch tower
entities.what: A tall platform of horizontal brick courses carrying the 望火楼's pavilion; a straight wooden stair with stringers, treads and a hand-rail climbs to its top from the lower left (west), arriving at its front-west corner; a railing of balusters runs along the front edge of the top. Its foot is hidden behind the roofs below it. Nobody stands on it or on the stair (余辉: a fire tower with no watchman).
entities.vis: part: foot hidden behind S2.bld.rear_shed_28380's roof (v >= 283); east end under willow whips
entities.src: sections.md S2: 望火楼 (余辉, a pavilion on a high brick platform)
entities.note: FRONT FACE (the strokes): brick courses clear at u 28393-28510, v 203-283, fainter to ~28548; its west edge a vertical at u ~28393 (v 187-283), its east end ~28548 under willow whips. Top edge v ~200-203; the railing on it v 180-197 from u 28400 to 28513. STAIR: two stringers with treads (28290,277)->(28387,187) and (28317,280)->(28393,207), a hand-rail (28280,247)->(28370,163): it climbs eastward against the platform's west side and lands at the front-west corner; its foot is hidden at v >= 280 (stair_foot est). HEIGHT: at least 80-85 px of painted face (v 200 to the hidden foot at v >= 283); no figure stands at its foot to compare (the sheds' customers below are at v 570-670, painted 110-140 px tall). BASE: sw/se are the face's ends at the hidden foot (est); the back corners are placeholders shifted (-45, -40) like the pavilion's back posts (the east tables' up-left recession; with the up-right reading they would be (+45, -40) instead). The restyle draws a wide stepped stone terrace from u 28315 to 28540: the steps are invented, the scan has one brick face and a wooden stair. sections.md's ≈ 28260-28580 is the pavilion's eaves (28313-28577) and the stair. Merge: t11 recorded a long low plank table or bench in the pavilion, S2.prop.table_pavilion_28455 (conf low; plank 28400-28508, v 181-196), retired: the same strokes are this platform's front railing (rail_w (28400, 182) to rail_e (28513, 182), v 180-197), which t11 gave as its other reading. Nobody and nothing stands in the pavilion (余辉: a tower with no watchman).

entities.name: 望火楼: the pavilion on the brick platform
entities.what: A small open pavilion on top of the brick platform: four posts carrying a pyramidal tiled roof with wide flaring eaves and a round finial on a pedestal at its peak; the platform's railing runs between its front posts. Nobody stands in it.
entities.vis: part: post feet hidden by the railing and the stair's rails
entities.note: Finial u 28420-28437, v 70-90 (top 70); roof from the finial to the eaves at v 143-152; eave corners (28313,150) and (28577,148). Four post lines: u 28343 (v 150 to ~230), 28387 (153 to ~240), 28490-28500 (153 to ~195), 28537-28545 (150 to ~220). READING (kept): front posts 28387 and 28540, standing on the ends of the brick face (28393 and 28548) with the railing between them, back posts 28343 and 28495 (shift -45 px): the up-left recession of the sheds' tables below (slopes +0.9 to +1.25, see the report). OTHER READING: front posts 28343 and 28495, back posts 28387 and 28540 (up-right recession, as west of u 26500); then the railing would run along the back. The post lines below v ~200 mix with the stair's rails. Feet est on the platform top. SCALE CUES: posts ~50-60 px from the platform top (v ~200) to the eave (v ~150); roof ~80 px from eave to finial; eave span 264 px; post spacing 153 px across the front.

entities.name: 望楼饭铺: the long thatched eating shed below the 望火楼
entities.what: A long open eating shed under thatch: a big hipped thatched roof with a small gable vent, a second lower thatched skirt roof along its front, and behind its east half a second big thatched roof; the roofs stand on many plain posts over tables, benches and seated customers (t11's and t12's); at its east end a wall of vertical slats (a bamboo or reed fence) closes the back, a slatted fringe hangs under the front eave and a short valance hangs across the east bay. A long slatted bench stands at its west end (t11's prop). The 望楼饭铺 of the scholars, at the edge of town.
entities.vis: part: back half under willow crowns; feet behind customers and benches
entities.src: 余辉: 望楼饭铺; 名画记: 城乡交界处 (pin 10) (setting)
entities.note: Upper hipped thatch: ridge (28353,360)->(28533,353), west hip to (28280,460), east hip to (28700,473); gable vent u 28653-28737, v 400-480. Lower front skirt of thatch v 470-540 from u 28393 to ~28930 (lower edge v ~533-540). Rear thatched roof u ~28600-29050, v 293-480, its east end at ~29030-29050 against the willow. Posts' feet: (28300,575), (28425,615), (28500,660), (28550,665), (28640,670), (28660,670), (28725,630), (28793,660), (28928,610), (28950,605) and the east bay's posts u 29011-29017 and 29043-29053 (v 497-630, t12; feet est). Slat wall u 28920-29030, v 485-570; slatted fringe under the eave u 28880-28910, v 540-566; valance u 28949-29014, v 496-507; the front skirt's east eave end (28926, 524-540). A pale lens-shaped mark on the upper thatch at (28564-28577, 327-350) (t11): a gourd, a hole or a patch. The long slatted bench / board rack (28300,530)->(28420,613) at the west end is a prop (t11). EAST END: its last post stands on the S1 seam (u 29043-29053); the shed is S2's by its footprint (Phase 0). Back corners est. The restyle paints the roofs as thatch too (right). SCALE CUES: eave skirt ~120-130 px above the posts' feet at v 660-670; posts 50-100 px apart.

entities.name: the far street behind the halls, at the top of the silk
entities.what: A street at the very top of the silk behind the long riverside halls: sheds with tables, a stall awning, a round-topped cart, animals and a few people along it; east of the great willow at the top it opens into the wide ground in front of the 王家纸马铺.
entities.vis: part: its south half hidden behind the halls' roof (top edge v ~145) west of u 26450
entities.note: No edge is drawn. edge_n: the sheds' and huts' fronts (S2.bld.far_shed_25785, far_long_shed_26260, mat_hut_26515) and the 纸马铺's floor line (v 200-203). edge_s: hidden behind the 沿河雅座/warehouse roof (top edge v ~145) as far as u ~26450; east of it the open ground under the willow slopes down to the bank, and in front of the 纸马铺 the ground runs to the low shed's roof (v ~323-330). The far street's figures stand at v 130-147 (t7). WEST END: at u 24620-24850 it shows above the scaffold house's banner pole, where t6's man by the pole stack (foot 24732,116) and basket porter (24804,120) walk; it starts at the open yard north-east of the cart (u 24500-24700, v 100-180, structures_w's S2.road.main side), and from u ~24850 to 25500 it is hidden behind the scaffold and the tall rear hall's roof (v 20-200; est). A side street, not the route (S2.road.main is structures_w's): see my report for the reading of the route.

entities.name: open yard east of the 纸马铺, under the pole frame
entities.what: Bare open ground east of the 纸马铺 between the long building at the top, the tall pole frame (t9's S2.prop.pole_frame_27490), the tiled shed's west gable and the eating shed's roof: empty except the frame, its trestle and leaning mat racks, a low stand and a porter with baskets (t9's and t10's). It opens south-east down to the wharf yard between the lower shed and the tiled shed.
entities.vis: part: edges hidden by roofs
entities.note: Bounded by the 纸马铺's east end (u ~27290, v 200), the pole frame's feet (v 300-340), the gabled shed's door posts (u 27692, v 413-438) and the eating shed's roof top edge (v ~400-470). The restyle fills it with about twelve invented people; the scan has none (setup's check at zoom 3).

entities.note: Upper line (28750,150)->(29050,150)->(29200,145); lower line (28780,170)->(28820,188)->(28980,192)->(29073,192); a third stroke runs from (28757,167) down-right to ~(28857,242). They cross the S1 seam at u 29050 (v 150 and ~192; the lines here stop there) and run on to (29200,145) and (29073,192): S1's structures_w records "the bank lines and the diagonal track at the top (≈ 29200-29900, v 90-300)".
